def second_largest(xs):
    """Second largest distinct value; None if fewer than two distinct."""
    uniq = sorted(set(xs), reverse=True)
    return uniq[1] if len(uniq) > 1 else None

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(second_largest([1, 2, 3]))
